title: senecio capitatus
intro: Senecio capitatus, commonly known as the round-headed groundsel, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the daisy family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Senecio capitatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and calm muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Senecio capitatus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
